varieties.name: Detroit Dark Red
varieties.traits: Deep red, round, globe-shaped roots; smooth skin; classic OP market type; ~55-60 days per search snippet
varieties.note: The standard, nationally-sold, seed-saveable beetroot in South Africa — added as a new entry (crop-catalog.ts had no prior varieties array for beetroot). Direct verbatim fetch was attempted against Sakata (both a guessed product URL and its beetroot category listing page) but both failed — see gaps — so this is sourced only via a WebSearch summary of the Starke Ayres product page, flagged rather than presented as independently verified.

evidence.quote: Detroit Dark Red produces deep red, round beetroot with smooth skin, ready to harvest in around 55-60 days.
evidence.doc: Detroit Dark Red Beetroot, Starke Ayres product page (via search snippet — JS-rendered page, not directly fetchable for a verbatim on-page quote)

varieties.name: Crimson Globe
varieties.traits: Round, deep crimson roots; reliable, widely adapted
varieties.note: A second nationally-marketed OP beetroot alternative to Detroit Dark Red; same sourcing caveat applies.

evidence.quote: Crimson Globe is a reliable variety producing round, deep crimson beetroot with good uniformity.
evidence.doc: Crimson Globe Beetroot, Starke Ayres product page (via search snippet — JS-rendered page, not directly fetchable for a verbatim on-page quote)
